lyrics.english: In a small fishbowl
flowers that don't breathe
bloomed pretty, but have no scent
you're just like me
what shows through the glass
what kind of place is the sea?

lyrics.russian: сколько ни плыву, хоть тысячу раз,
lyrics.english: no matter how many thousand times I swim

lyrics.russian: мне до него так и не доплыть
lyrics.english: I still can't reach it
and at some point

lyrics.russian: мы, что остались в этом привычном месте,
lyrics.english: we who stayed in this place we got used to

lyrics.russian: опять слишком много тревоги и страха —
lyrics.english: again, too much worry and fear
everything blurs together

lyrics.korean: 새로운 먼 곳에 저 파도가 넘실대는 바다에
lyrics.russian: в новую даль, в море, где ходят волны,
lyrics.english: to a new faraway place, to that sea where the waves roll
I'll let it carry me and drift away

lyrics.korean: 이 작은 공간에 한 발을 내디뎌
lyrics.russian: делаю шаг прочь из этой тесноты
lyrics.english: I take a step out of this small space
into that sparkling, endless sea
old, where no one ever comes

lyrics.korean: 이끼만 가득 찬 이 흐린 유리를 넘어
lyrics.russian: мутное стекло, всё во мху, — перешагну через него
lyrics.english: past this cloudy glass, all covered in moss

lyrics.russian: растеряю по дороге свои маленькие мечты
lyrics.english: dropping a few of my small dreams along the way
and I'll seep into this sea

lyrics.russian: звезда, на которую я смотрю из аквариума,
lyrics.english: the star I look up at from inside the fishbowl
one day spoke to me
child, you're still young
and that sea keeps flowing

lyrics.russian: твой мир не там, где ты сейчас
lyrics.english: your world isn't where you are now

lyrics.russian: круглое небо, на которое ты смотришь снизу, —
lyrics.english: the round sky you look up at

lyrics.russian: это ещё не всё; выберись оттуда —
lyrics.english: isn't all there is — get out of there
and the sky will look different

lyrics.korean: 조금씩 금이 가 점점 물이 빠지고
lyrics.english: cracks spread bit by bit, the water drains away

lyrics.korean: 그 사이를 힘껏 부딪쳐 깨질 듯한 벽
lyrics.russian: бьюсь изо всех сил в стену, что вот-вот треснет
lyrics.english: I throw myself at the wall that's about to break

lyrics.korean: 날카롭게 부서진 유리 조각이 조금 박혀도
lyrics.english: even if the sharp shards dig into me
it's okay — it's almost time
